stages.label: Research Technical Options
stages.description: Compare libraries or technical approaches with verified sources; never implement.
stages.summary: Compare libraries or technical approaches with verified sources; never implement.

stages.label: Repository Contribution Scout
stages.description: Audit the entire tracked repository, maintainer priorities, and suggest ranked PR-sized contribution plans; never implement.
stages.summary: Repository-wide contribution discovery, source-grounded roadmap and PR plans (read-only).

stages.label: Assess Codebase
stages.description: Trace relevant entry points, ownership, conventions and tests; record sources and unknowns. No application edits.
stages.summary: Trace relevant entry points, ownership, conventions and tests; record sources and unknowns. No application edits.

stages.label: Diagnose Root Cause
stages.description: Reproduce and trace a bug or failure before any fix. Writes hypotheses, evidence, and confirmed cause.
stages.summary: Reproduce and trace a bug or failure before any fix. Writes hypotheses, evidence, and confirmed cause.

stages.label: Extract Existing Behaviour
stages.description: Extract observed behaviour and invariants from code, without guessing or changing application source.
stages.summary: Extract observed behaviour and invariants from code, without guessing or changing application source.

stages.label: Plan Goals
stages.description: Decompose authorised outcomes into dependencies, constraints and acceptance criteria; no implementation.
stages.summary: Decompose authorised outcomes into dependencies, constraints and acceptance criteria; no implementation.

stages.label: Consult Architecture
stages.description: Write an ADR and implementation boundaries; no source edits.
stages.summary: Write an ADR and implementation boundaries; no source edits.

stages.label: Design UI
stages.description: Read real design tokens and components; produce a UI specification and interaction states only.
stages.summary: Read real design tokens and components; produce a UI specification and interaction states only.

stages.label: Review UI Specification
stages.description: Check design contract for implementability, consistency, responsive behaviour and ownership; independent review.
stages.summary: Check design contract for implementability, consistency, responsive behaviour and ownership; independent review.

stages.label: Plan Code Changes
stages.description: Create file- and test-specific implementation steps, in the same record; does not execute.
stages.summary: Create file- and test-specific implementation steps, in the same record; does not execute.

stages.label: Plan Tests Only
stages.description: Define assertions, fixtures and required RED/GREEN checks without writing or running tests.
stages.summary: Define assertions, fixtures and required RED/GREEN checks without writing or running tests.

stages.label: Review Plan
stages.description: Review requirement coverage, execution feasibility and plan revision. Does not implement.
stages.summary: Review requirement coverage, execution feasibility and plan revision. Does not implement.

stages.label: Write Failing Tests
stages.description: Write tests, capture expected RED assertion, and refuse to treat infrastructure errors as RED.
stages.summary: Write tests, capture expected RED assertion, and refuse to treat infrastructure errors as RED.

stages.label: Execute Approved Plan
stages.description: Apply approved plan against current reviewed revision. Preserve scope, checkpoints and evidence.
stages.summary: Apply approved plan against current reviewed revision. Preserve scope, checkpoints and evidence.

stages.label: Fix Reviewed Defects
stages.description: Apply only separately authorised actionable findings; do not self-authorise scope changes.
stages.summary: Apply only separately authorised actionable findings; do not self-authorise scope changes.

stages.label: Run Tests & Validation
stages.description: Run existing build/lint/typecheck/unit/integration commands; capture exits and logs without feature implementation.
stages.summary: Run existing build/lint/typecheck/unit/integration commands; capture exits and logs without feature implementation.

stages.label: Run End-to-End Tests
stages.description: Run current browser journeys and capture screenshots/traces; never run build first.
stages.summary: Run current browser journeys and capture screenshots/traces; never run build first.

stages.label: Review Code
stages.description: Review diff with evidence; reviewer cannot implement its own suggested changes.
stages.summary: Review diff with evidence; reviewer cannot implement its own suggested changes.

stages.label: Review Visual Fidelity
stages.description: Compare rendered UI to existing design or approved UI spec, with screenshot evidence.
stages.summary: Compare rendered UI to existing design or approved UI spec, with screenshot evidence.

stages.label: Review Accessibility
stages.description: Assess keyboard, focus, semantics and responsive interaction with reproducible evidence; no automatic UI changes.
stages.summary: Assess keyboard, focus, semantics and responsive interaction with reproducible evidence; no automatic UI changes.

stages.label: Review Security
stages.description: Bounded independent static/runtime security verification; report defects without expanding privileges.
stages.summary: Bounded independent static/runtime security verification; report defects without expanding privileges.

stages.label: Review Dependency Risk
stages.description: Review new package choices, provenance, licenses and supply-chain exposure. Does not install dependencies.
stages.summary: Review new package choices, provenance, licenses and supply-chain exposure. Does not install dependencies.

stages.label: Verify Delivered Goals
stages.description: Confirm observable outcomes and requirements, rather than only counting tasks.
stages.summary: Confirm observable outcomes and requirements, rather than only counting tasks.

stages.label: Update Documentation
stages.description: Update affected docs from real code diff; do not rebuild source code.
stages.summary: Update affected docs from real code diff; do not rebuild source code.

stages.label: Verify Documentation
stages.description: Check each documentation claim and command against actual code.
stages.summary: Check each documentation claim and command against actual code.

stages.label: Verify Performance
stages.description: Independently run performance checks against named baselines and budgets; capture commands, metrics and logs without implementing changes.
stages.summary: Verified performance evidence only.
